summary: The implementation successfully fulfills all 7 requirements from the BuildRequest. The diff shows a complete todo list application with frontend components (TodoInput, TodoList, PassiveAggressiveModal), backend persistence (Motoko actor), and a warm earth-tone visual theme. All acceptance criteria are met, including the passive-aggressive modal behavior, red text on uncheck, strikethrough on check, and backend persistence.

hallucinated_features.description: Task removal functionality via removeTask backend method
hallucinated_features.reason: The backend includes a removeTask function in main.mo, but the BuildRequest explicitly states in non-goals: Task deletion functionality. This feature was not requested.
